about_the_game:
Godway is a fast-paced platform game set on the rails.
All you have to do: run, jump, and make your move at the right time. As the rails lead you to the top, obstacles and gaps will try to block your way.

🛤️ Key Features:

  • Rail-Based Platform Action: Stay on the rails, keep moving, and don’t fall.

  • Reflex-Oriented Gameplay: Speed, timing, and focus are the keys to success.

  • Increasing Challenge: The closer you get to the summit, the harder and more dangerous the path becomes.

  • Evolving Character: Run faster, jump higher.

  • Minimalist Atmosphere: Simple yet memorable visuals.

  • Addictive Gameplay: Can mesmerize both players and viewers.

How far can you go on the rail to the top?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Intel 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A breathtaking run on rails to the heavens! Godway tests you with dynamic obstacles, platform jumping, and escalating difficulty. Fall, rise again, and push your limits to claim your place beside the god at the summit. The path to immortality begins here.
